</nowiki>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="ful-of-energy-but-nowhere-to-go"><ins><nowiki>Ful of Energy But Nowhere To Go</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Defeat TzKal-Zuk in hard mode in a single run without moving after attacking the 'Conduit of Ful' in wave 18.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You are allowed to move after the conduit has spawned, just not after you have started attacking it</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Phasing Zuk at 100k HP:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Make sure to be at full health, max </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1" alt="necrosis" title="necrosis" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><strong><nowiki>Conduit 1:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
